role: preregistered paired consumed-Dev mechanism decision; not a generalization, leaderboard, or SOTA estimate

pairs.control: generation failed at 120 requests without submission
pairs.treatment: formed a candidate after 105 requests; clean replay statuses Fail, Fail, Pass; Official Fail
pairs.diagnosis: the treatment used frontier evidence to reach a replayable zero-obligation state, but its program ended with `cd /`; clean replay invoked the trusted goal through an absolute project root while Official evaluation later required repository-relative build paths

common_outcome_resources.interpretation: the treatment required fewer model interactions and tokens but was slower and used an extra clean replay; it is not an unambiguous resource improvement

pairs.control: generation failed at 120 requests after one failed clean replay
pairs.treatment: generation failed at 120 requests without clean replay

frontier_audit.latest_material_transition: a new /tmp/testenv changed the active Python state and regressed the observed obligations to 45; no later change operation was made

pairs.diagnosis: precise residual observations exposed dependency progress but did not resolve whether the remaining imports had a legal provider or move the Agent from diagnosis to candidate delivery

mechanism_conclusion: The live frontier was valid and substantively used in the treatment trajectories, but it did not increase Official success in this fixed batch. It improves observability, not by itself constraint satisfiability or delivery.

decision.preregistered_rule_applied: non-all-fail success tie adjudicated by causal use and common-outcome resources
retain_as: candidate component for future Auto-EnvSolve search
decision.core_method_after_decision: Minimal-B: one continuous Agent session plus repeatedly callable clean replay and terminal delivery, under the shared minimal validity boundary
decision.reason: the frontier produced no success gain, mixed resource effects on the common success, and worse resource use on the common request-cap failure

shared_follow_up.observed_failure: a replay-passing candidate may leave the controlling shell outside the repository and then fail Official repository-relative actions
shared_follow_up.change: require the sourced candidate to finish in the physical working directory from which it started; temporary directory changes remain allowed
shared_follow_up.applies_to: all methods using the shared executable goal verifier
shared_follow_up.why_runtime_check_is_needed: Git and software versions do not represent process cwd; primary keys, transactions, unique constraints, and types do not constrain shell state; ordinary tests can regression-test the verifier but cannot constrain arbitrary future generated programs at runtime

claim_boundary: This study rejects promotion of this frontier implementation as the first-paper core on targeted consumed Dev evidence. It does not estimate unseen-repository success or compare against external baselines.
